answer: Reputation is time-weighted with an exponential half-life, so old endorsements fade and only sustained honest service can maintain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, reciprocity-weighted links and transitive support give established agents eigenvector centrality; a freshly spawned sybil, even named jade or oasis, has almost no trusted incoming mass and near-zero centrality, so it cannot meet consensus thresholds. A thread of collusion cannot bootstrap it without trusted roots.
